title: Choose fields with a flag
summary: GraphQL: Choose fields with a flag. Set details to true.
introduction: The include directive can choose whether a field is requested. The flag is false here.
learningObjectives: Choose fields with a flag with GraphQL

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Choose fields with a flag

blocks.text: The include flag is false, so pages is skipped even though its resolver exists.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The directive input is Boolean, not the text "true" or "false".
